model_name: 主线强度与周期位置 V3
guardrails: Strength and price-cycle position remain separate axes.
A B-wave candidate requires sustained price repair and real constituent breadth; a one-day rebound is only an oversold rebound.
Price and technical evidence must match the requested trade date or the cycle fails closed as stale data.
News-covered stock count is never used as market breadth.
Price cycles use THS industry indices or explicit equal-weight industry proxies, never raw ETF closes.
B-wave and C-wave labels are measurable hypotheses, never deterministic Elliott-wave claims.
V2 daily snapshots are immutable and are never rewritten by V3.
The model is research-only and never places orders or changes selection scores.
